source.name: Can I take over XYZ?
source.notice: Fingerprint patterns are heuristic and have not been independently tested against live provider accounts by this project.

services.remediation: Restore the intended GitHub Pages site or remove the CNAME.

services.fingerprint: The specified bucket does not exist
services.remediation: Restore the intended S3 bucket or remove the CNAME.

Restore the intended Heroku app or remove the CNAME.

Restore the Zendesk help center or remove the CNAME.

services.remediation: Restore the Ghost publication or remove the CNAME.
